goal: Build a responsive UNO card game with up to 10 players, dynamic player positioning, full game rules (draw, skip, reverse, wild cards), touch/desktop controls, and AI opponents

tasks.name: Setup responsive game canvas with dynamic player layout
tasks.description: Create a responsive game container that displays the UNO table, centered player count selector (1-10 players), and dynamically positions player panels in a circular/oval arrangement around the central discard pile. Use CSS Grid/Flexbox for responsive scaling across all devices.
acceptanceCriteria: Game container fills viewport and scales on desktop, tablet, and mobile
Player count selector (1-10) is visible and centered at top of UI
Player panels reposition dynamically around the table when player count changes
Central discard pile area and draw deck are visible in the center
tasks.codeHints: const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); const [playerCount, setPlayerCount] = useState(4); const getPlayerPosition = (index: number, total: number) => { const angle = (index / total) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI/2; return { x: 50 + 40 * Math.cos(angle), y: 50 + 35 * Math.sin(angle) }; }; // Use CSS: width: clamp(60px, 8vw, 100px) for responsive cards

tasks.name: Implement core UNO game logic and card interactions
tasks.description: Build complete UNO mechanics: card deck generation (4 colors, numbers 0-9, skip, reverse, draw-2, wild, wild-draw-4), turn system with direction tracking, card validation (match color/number), special card effects, UNO call detection, and AI opponents with basic/medium difficulty. Handle draw pile reshuffling.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping/clicking a valid card plays it to discard pile with visual feedback
Skip, Reverse, Draw-2, Wild, and Wild-Draw-4 cards trigger correct effects
Invalid card selections show error feedback and are rejected
AI opponents take turns automatically with visible card plays
Game detects when a player has one card and when someone wins
tasks.codeHints: const gameState = useRef({ deck: [], discard: [], hands: [], currentPlayer: 0, direction: 1, currentColor: null }); const isValidPlay = (card, topCard, currentColor) => card.type === 'wild' || card.color === currentColor || card.value === topCard.value; const handleSpecialCard = (card) => { if(card.value === 'skip') nextTurn(2); if(card.value === 'reverse') gameState.current.direction *= -1; };

tasks.name: Review mobile-first implementation, restart flow, and generate image assets
tasks.description: Audit full game loop for mobile touch responsiveness (tap to select/play cards, drag support), verify restart functionality resets all state properly, ensure smooth animations on all devices, validate scorekeeping accuracy, and prompt user to generate custom UNO card image assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Touch interactions work smoothly on mobile (tap to select, tap to play)
Restart/New Game button resets all players, hands, deck, and scores correctly
Turn progression, score tracking, and win detection function without errors across full games
tasks.codeHints: const handleRestart = () => { gameState.current = { deck: shuffleDeck(createDeck()), hands: dealHands(playerCount), currentPlayer: 0, direction: 1, scores: Array(playerCount).fill(0) }; setGamePhase('playing'); }; // Touch: onTouchStart, onTouchEnd with e.preventDefault(); // Prompt user: 'Generate UNO card assets with consistent style for all 108 cards'
